description: Reads the homepage of a store and returns the platform, the theme (on Shopify: the name the store gave it, the Theme Store theme it was built on, its version and whether it was renamed; on WordPress and Magento: the theme folder), the third-party apps found on the page (about 65 ecommerce apps such as Klaviyo, Judge.me, Rebuy, Recharge, grouped by category) and the tracking tags with their IDs. Apps that only run in checkout or the back office leave no trace on the homepage. One GET request. Counts against the free daily limit unless the store was scanned in the last ten minutes.

url.description: Store domain or homepage URL, for example store.com

name: detect_store_stack
title: Detect the theme, apps and tracking tags of a store
